canonicalization_rules.area: AREA parsed only when explicit sq.ft. unit is present; ranges preserved
canonicalization_rules.csv: UTF-8 without BOM, LF line endings, fixed source-then-derived column order
canonicalization_rules.deduplication: none; all source rows retained; exact duplicates are flagged, not removed
canonicalization_rules.location: ast.literal_eval dictionary only; CITY_NAME and LOCALITY_NAME extracted when available
canonicalization_rules.map_details: ast.literal_eval dictionary only; coordinate ranges validated
canonicalization_rules.posting_date: POSTING_DATE is Unix milliseconds; parse explicitly as milliseconds, convert the instant to Asia/Kolkata, then derive posting_month; invalid dates remain retained and unassigned to a month
canonicalization_rules.price_bounds: MIN_PRICE/MAX_PRICE must be numeric, finite, positive, non-sentinel, and coherent (MIN_PRICE <= MAX_PRICE); ineligible records are retained with reason flags
canonicalization_rules.price_sqft: PRICE_SQFT is preserved; values >= 100000 are review flags only and are not automatically excluded
canonicalization_rules.row_identity: source_row_id is the stable zero-based raw-row ordinal; source row order retained
canonicalization_rules.source_area_columns: MIN_AREA_SQFT/MAX_AREA_SQFT retained unchanged and only audited under the sqm-to-sqft hypothesis
canonicalization_rules.text: strip boundary whitespace; empty strings represent missing values

row_order: preserved; source_row_id is the zero-based raw row ordinal
